title: Settings
subtitle: Make OLEACHRON work the way you like.

account.profileHelp: This is the name other people see on your work.
account.emailHelp: We send a code to the new address. It becomes your sign-in email only after you enter the code.
account.codeSent: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
account.emailUpdated: Email updated. Sign in with it on your other devices.
account.devCode: Email delivery is not configured in this build. Your code is {{code}}.
account.passwordHelp: Choose a new password. You stay signed in on this device.
account.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

appearance.largeControlsDesc: Bigger tap targets for easier use.
appearance.easyUsePresetDesc: Turns on large text and large controls together.
appearance.livePreviewNote: Changes apply live on this page.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.accountHint: Saved to your account with your inbox. The same choices apply on every device where you sign in.
notifications.accountHintDemo: Saved to this demo account in the browser, with sample assignment and approval notices. On a live OLEACHRON account they follow you to every device.

prefsHints.taskAssignment: When someone assigns you field work.
prefsHints.approval: When a task needs or receives approval.

privacy.exportHelp: Download a copy of your profile, notification choices, fields, and notifications. Photos and money records can be requested from support.
privacy.supportBody: For a correction, a complete archive, or written confirmation that grove data was deleted, email OLEACHRON support. Include the account email you sign in with.

sessions.thisDeviceHint: OLEACHRON only tracks the session on this browser. Sign out to end it.

danger.deleteHelp: Closing your account signs you out and removes your name and email from the login. Grove records stay until support confirms they were deleted.
danger.confirmBody: Enter your password and type your email to confirm. You will be signed out.
danger.emailMismatch: That does not match your email.

technical.purpose: Share the app version with support if something goes wrong.
technical.supportHint: Mention this version when you contact OLEACHRON support.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Reset the demo back to the original story if things get messy.
demo.resetConfirm: Reset demo data? This will restore the original demo fields, tasks, and assignments.
